About me

Strategy meets
empathy.

I'm Truc Nguyen, based in Ho Chi Minh City. Marketing, to me, sits at the intersection of human insight, data patterns, and business goals — and that's exactly where I operate.

I specialise in growth through content strategy and product-led campaigns, while building the internal systems that help teams perform consistently. I've led cross-functional marketing teams, designed hiring and onboarding workflows, and built the SOPs that keep execution sharp at scale.

Sustainable results don't happen by accident. They're built.
